data.narrative:
NuScale Power operates in the nuclear energy sector, a space populated by 3 public and 6 private peers. The company has raised over $600M to date and is now public. The comparable universe includes listed companies trading under tickers OKLO, NNE, and SMR, alongside private developers including Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, and Fuse Energy.

A peer-median valuation approach is not applicable to NuScale given the scarcity of direct comparables. The nuclear energy sector contains only five same-stage companies total, but filtering for peers at identical development stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier yields fewer than three datapoints—below the minimum threshold needed for robust median analysis. Relying on all-sector medians would introduce material distortion and is therefore not pursued.

The valuation of NuScale cannot be triangulated reliably through conventional multiples-based methods given data constraints. Valuation support would require either (1) DCF analysis grounded in project cash flow timing and cost-of-capital assumptions specific to advanced nuclear deployment, or (2) granular transaction precedent analysis among the five same-sector peers, neither of which is present in the available dataset. Key uncertainties include regulatory approval timelines, capital intensity of first-of-a-kind units, and long-cycle project financing viability. Without additional financial metrics or precedent transaction data, a quantitative range cannot be responsibly supported.
